name: GetDetails
title: GetDetails
description: Get the pricing information from your realm either in JSON or XML format

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the realm. 
 Example: s4All

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description:
$filter=expression. ‘expression’ is a combination of resource parameters,$filter=expression. ‘expression’ is a combination of resource parameters, values. Operator ‘eq’ and 'in' is used to link parameter and value. Operator ‘and’ is used to link two or more parameters. For example, $filter=a eq ‘b’ and c eq 'd’. Following parameters are supported in current implementation.
 objectType(optional) 
 fromDate(required) 
 toDate(required) 
The date should use the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssX ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME date format. ex:- 2018-01-01T23:59:59-08:00  
Pricing DB objectType: RFX,RFXItem,RFXItemSupplier,RFXStandardTerm,RFXCustomTerm,Item,ItemPrice,ItemAMLSplit,Bom,AML,ItemAttribute,BomSplit,ItemPlant,
ItemProgram,Plant,Program,LeadTime,CustomFields,ItemTags,BomTags.

Valid  combinations are 
1. fromDate eq '2020-02-12T00:58:15-08:00' and toDate eq '2020-02-12T23:58:15-08:00' (return all ObjectTypes) 
2. objectType eq 'item' and fromdate eq '2020-02-12T00:58:15-08:00' and todate eq '2020-02-12T23:58:15-08:00'
3. objectType in ('Item', 'RFX', 'Bom', 'Plant') and fromdate eq '2020-02-12T00:58:15-08:00' and todate eq '2020-02-12T23:58:15-08:00'
 
 Example: objectType in (ItemPrice, bom) and fromdate eq '2020-04-29T09:30:00-08:00' and todate eq '2020-04-29T21:50:00-08:00'
